name: Mixed Green Salad with Pork Sausage, Apple, Almonds & Italian Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 Gala apples
3 (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring often, until lightly toasted and fragrant, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl.
When the sausages are almost done, add mixed greens and toasted almonds to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
Slice sausages crosswise into thin rounds.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with sausage. Enjoy!
